Group Managing Director @ AssetRise | Alternative Investments · I am Oluwasdurotimi Ojamamoye an alternative investment and risk analyst, I guide investors through today’s challenging economic landscape to build secure, profitable portfolios. Nigeria is facing severe economic volatility, with inflation hitting 34.19% in June 2024, driven by global supply disruptions, subsidy removals, and Naira depreciation. Traditional investments, especially in the stock market, have suffered, leading to reduced returns and eroded purchasing power.

The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) raised the Monetary Policy Rate to 26.25%, which has further constrained borrowing and access to capital. Inflation is expected to remain above 20%, adding to the challenges for investors and businesses alike. Despite these hurdles, Nigeria’s GDP grew to 3.19% in Q2 2024, driven by the services sector. However, issues such as poor infrastructure, security concerns, and fluctuating oil prices still weigh heavily on the economy.
